parameters.value: A high-temperature device that heats materials in an enclosed chamber, isolating them from direct contact with heating elements to ensure clean and precise sintering.

A robust outer steel casing, ceramic or refractory muffle chamber, embedded high-temperature heating elements, thermal insulation, secure door seals, temperature controllers, and exhaust systems for safe and uniform heating of samples.
Kanthal (Iron-Chromium-Aluminum alloy), Nichrome (Nickel-Chromium alloy), Silicon Carbide (SiC) rods, Molybdenum Disilicide (MoSi?) rod, Magnetron
Mild Steel duly powder coated, Stainless Steel
